title: Whitelabel brand token set
description: Canonical brand token schema shared by Nexspire-admin, nexcrm-frontend and nexcrm-storefront. One file per brand in brands/<slug>.json, selected at build time with VITE_BRAND. See nexcrm-agents/shared/whitelabel-execution-plan.md (P0-01).

productName.description: Full product name shown in UI chrome, page titles and emails.

productShortName.description: Compact form for collapsed sidebars and mobile headers. Falls back to productName.

companyLegalName.description: Legal entity for invoice footers and email footers.

crmProductName.description: Name of the CRM product SKU, e.g. NapCRM. Falls back to productName.

mailProductName.description: Name of the email-marketing product SKU, e.g. NapMail. Falls back to productName.

baseDomain.description: Root domain for tenant hostnames, e.g. napnix.in. Must match NEXCRM_DOMAIN on the backend.

logoLight.description: Logo for light backgrounds. Path under public/.

logoMark.description: Square icon form, used for collapsed sidebar and mobile.

primary.description: Base brand colour. If brandScale is omitted, the 50-950 scale is derived from this.

primaryFg.description: Foreground colour that must read on top of primary.

brandScale.description: Explicit 50-950 ramp. Supply this when an existing palette must be preserved exactly; otherwise it is derived from primary.

fontFamily.description: CSS font-family stack. Null keeps the app default.

customCss.description: Raw CSS injected last. Escape hatch only - prefer tokens.

legacyDomains.description: Retired base domains this brand still answers on, so old bookmarks keep resolving. A new brand ships an empty list.

tagline.description: Short descriptor appended to the page title and used as the meta description, e.g. 'Customer Relationship Management'.
